items.title: RBI moves 60 tonnes of gold to India in 6 months
items.summary: Reserve Bank of India shifted 60.1 tonnes of gold to domestic storage, raising domestic holdings to 740.1 tonnes. This transfer reflects a growing preference for domestic gold custody among central banks. As of September 2026, total gold reserves remained at 880.5 tonnes. India's forex reserves increased to $737.8 billion in September, despite a decline in gold's share of these reserves.
